events.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win

updates.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
updates.raw_title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
updates.why_relevant: 德国政局与极右翼冲突
facts: Merz was addressing the Bundestag in the aftermath of the anti-immigration party's sweeping victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt where it won almost 44% of the vote, while the chancellor's conservatives saw their vote halved.
Merz hit back saying the AfD had harmed German interests by backing Russia, and its "remigration" policy would affect millions.

The AfD's success has been praised by US President Donald Trump, who said "the Populist Party in Germany just had a really big night", linking the victory to "absolutely horrible immigration rules and regulations".

events.title: Barclays raises S&P 500 year-end target, citing 'standout' earnings driven by AI

updates.title: Barclays raises S&P 500 year-end target, citing 'standout' earnings driven by AI
updates.raw_title: Barclays raises S&P 500 year-end target, citing 'standout' earnings driven by AI
updates.why_relevant: 上调标普目标，AI 盈利驱动
facts: Barclays raised its year-end S & P 500 target to 7,950 from 7,800, after what the bank called "a standout earnings season led by tech." "We raise our FY26/FY27 EPS estimates to $365/$414 and our YE26/YE27 S & P 500 [price target] to 7950/8800 following a standout earnings season
Big Tech earnings grew 35% from a year earlier in the second quarter, up from 30% in the last quarter, while earnings for the rest of the tech sector jumped 88%.
The analyst said Big Tech earnings continued beat-and-raise execution, reinforcing AI-driven earnings durability.
